g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
7:- [Slack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/slack.md): Run MCPJam from Slack — mention the bot to ask about your projects, and appr
ove the actions that spend credits
87:- [Preview draft judge grading on one recorded iteration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-draft-judge-g
rading-on-one-recorded-iteration.md): Uses model budget and complete recorded evidence without changing the run verdict. Supply ru
bric.instructions, optional structured criteria, or null for objective-only grading. Continue with the unchanged rubric and return
ed cursor, sourceHash and reservationId. Completed page retries return cached…
96:- [Preview a failed-cases rerun](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-a-failed-cases-rerun.md): What `POST /
projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun` with `scope: "failed_cases"` would execute, before anything spends. The platform sel
ects every case with a trial that is not completed and passed; cancelled and skipped trials do not count. `reasons` and `excluded`
count trials; `selectedCase…
125:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpj
am-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organiza
tion's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
144:- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md)
: The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current b
illing window, and how much of it has been spent.
145:- [Set the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/set-the-organizations-spend-budget.md):
Set or replace the ceiling. **Requires organization owner or admin.**
146:- [Remove the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/remove-the-organizations-spend-budget
.md): Leave the organization uncapped. **Requires organization owner or admin.**
147:- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belo
ngs to — the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to o
ne organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public
API.
203:- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No cr
edits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDa
y` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.
235:- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-execution-caps.md): The spend dia
l for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT — send every field. These caps only mean something as a set, and a partial update tha
t raised one while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobody chose.
245:- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-win
dow.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the
organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request her
e takes one from there.
257:- [Get a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/get-a-connection-request.md): Current st
ate of one connection request. Metered on its own poll budget rather than the shared per-caller one, so polling on a short interva
l is expected and will not spend the budget your other calls need. A 429 here means the poll interval itself is too fast; honour R
etry-After.
288:- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The det
erministic rubric result for one run. No model, no spend.
297:- [Start a Muse connector readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-muse-connector-read
iness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Meta's Muse connector guidelines and returns `202` with a run id. Free: Muse readin
ess has no AI observations, so the body has no field that can spend, and no submission mode, which belongs to the OpenAI plugin di
rectory. The submission-ready verdict stays `incomplete…
